parole.significato: rhinoceros, any large herbivorous ungulate with thick, gray skin and one or two horns on its snout
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish کركدن (kergeden), from Classical Persian کَرْگَدَن (kargadan, “Indian rhinoceros”), from Sanskrit खड्गधेनु (khaḍgadhenu, “female rhinoceros”), the feminine form of खड्ग (khaḍga, “horn, sword”).

parole.significato: mung bean, maash, the edible seed of the plant Vigna radiata, native to South Asia
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish ماش (maş), from Classical Persian ماش (mâš), ultimately from Sanskrit माष (māṣa, “mungo bean”).

parole.significato: jackal, any of certain wild canids of the genera Lupulella and Canis, specifically Canis aureus
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish چقال (çakal), from Classical Persian شغال (šaġâl), from Sanskrit सृगाल (sṛgāla, “jackal”), from Proto-Indo-Aryan *śr̥gālás, a suffixed derivative of Proto-Indo-Iranian *ćárguš (“predatory animal”).
